description: Account trigger for a sidebar footer: name + role expanded, avatar-only when the surrounding rail is collapsed (reacts to a collapsed SideNav / app shell). Presentation-only — the consumer supplies the user and the menu actions.
example:
/* Presentation only: the account trigger for a sidebar footer. The consumer
 * owns the user object and what each action does. */

<UserMenu
  name="Sarah Al-Mansouri"
  role="Brand manager"
  menuLabel="Account menu"
  actions={[
    { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', icon: 'person', onSelect: () => undefined },
    { id: 'logout', label: 'Sign out', icon: 'logout', onSelect: () => undefined },
  ]}
/>
